standard_prerequisites.name: The circle code and its total space
standard_prerequisites.statement: The code family assigns a type to each point of the circle, and the total space consists of a point together with an element of its code.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the type shown to be contractible.

standard_prerequisites.name: The flattening lemma
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a span whose pushout is a higher inductive type and a family with an equivalence datum, the total space of the induced family is again a higher inductive type with explicit constructors.
standard_prerequisites.use: It rewrites the total space as a higher inductive type with a point constructor and paths between consecutive integers.

standard_prerequisites.name: Induction on the integers
standard_prerequisites.statement: A family over the integers with a point at zero and steps in both directions has a section.
standard_prerequisites.use: It builds the paths from the centre to every point of the resulting type.

core_obligations: Apply the flattening lemma with the unit span, the constant family at the integers and the successor equivalence, obtaining that the total space of the circle code is equivalent to the higher inductive type with a point for every integer and a path between consecutive integers (source lines 669-681).
Choose the point at zero as centre of contraction and prove that every point is equal to it by induction on the resulting higher inductive type (source lines 685-687).
Define the paths from the centre to the points by induction on the integer, with the successor and predecessor steps built from the given paths between consecutive integers (source lines 687-693).

Check the path constructor, which reduces to the equation that the defined path concatenated with the generator equals the next defined path, verified by induction on the integer (source lines 695-698).

proof_roadmap.step: Rewrite the total space by the flattening lemma.
Centre of contraction and paths to all points by induction on the integers.
Check the path constructor and conclude contractibility.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 665-667: the total space of the circle code is contractible. The statement is a single contractibility claim, and the proof (source lines 668-699) is a construction: it first applies the flattening lemma with an explicit choice of span, family and equivalence to identify the total space with a higher inductive type generated by a point for each integer and a path between consecutive points, then proves that type contractible by choosing the point at zero as centre and building, by induction on the integers, a path from the centre to every generator, and finally verifies the path constructor by showing that the constructed path concatenated with the generator equals the next constructed path, again by induction. The author calls that last verification easy, which this card records verbatim; the flattening application and the two inductions are the substance and none of them is visible in the statement.
